preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output should be 0 if the input is an empty string.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(dict_scores.get(char.upper(), 0) for char in input if char.isalpha())
postconditions.description: The output should be the sum of the Scrabble values of the alphabetic characters in the input string.
